_description: Threshold sensitivity analysis of the SRI Method C engine. Every decision threshold was varied across a plausible range and the SRI recomputed, to establish how far the result depends on values that were chosen by judgement rather than fixed by the official catalogue.
_method: For each threshold, three values spanning a plausible range. Only the check functions that read the threshold were re-run; all other service results were held at their baseline. 25 thresholds, 75 runs.

summary.conclusion: No threshold, varied across its plausible range, changes the SRI class. The result is robust to the values chosen.
